title: I loved all of it especially the guide and the cheese!
text:
I went to the amazing mountains and walked on an amazing trail. The views the guide and the tastings were spectacular. Most of all I loved our tour guide. Her name was Kyra she spoke English so well and had amazing suggestions. She always knew what to do and how to help. She was hilarious and a fantastic guide.
This was an amazing day and Kyra was the one person who made it even better.

title: Montserrat Half Day Tour
text:
Our tour guide, Daria, was knowledgeable, humorous and engaging. She made the tour enjoyable while sharing fascinating insights into the geological formation of Montserrat. Montserrat is truly a beautiful place worth a visit to!

The tour also included a visit to the Holy Virgin Mary in the Basilica, where we had the opportunity to touch her hand and make a wish. Despite this being only Daria’s second time guiding this tour, she did an amazing job!
